cloakroom: Available through private local stalls outside the temple gates for a nominal locker fee , as mobile phones and large bags are strictly prohibited inside the main complex.
drinking_water: Basic drinking water taps are available on the outer premises, though pilgrims are highly advised to carry their own water bottles due to heavy crowd congestion.
toilets: Public restrooms and basic toilet blocks are available near the main vehicle parking grounds outside the temple compound.
footwear_counter: Available via private vendor stands near the parking and entrance areas for a nominal storage charge.
annadanam: The temple does not accept monetary donations or run a commercial free-meal scheme. Devotees can purchase food or prasadam at local stalls outside the temple gates.
wheelchair_accessibility: The temple does not provide on-site wheelchair rentals or assistance services. Personal foldable wheelchairs are permitted inside, but navigating inner walking lanes can be difficult during peak hours.
parking: Spacious parking area for private vehicles, buses, and two-wheelers outside the temple outer boundary.
other_facilities: Providing free entry and Darshan facility for all visiting pilgrims without any commercial discrimination.
Basic primary medical aid and first-aid facility on the temple premises to assist pilgrims in case of exhaustion or emergencies.
Maintaining standard sanitation and cleanliness in and around the Devasthanam area through volunteers.
